summary.reply:
### Detailed Overview of Desire Infoweb's Products

Desire Infoweb specializes in **SharePoint and Microsoft 365 web parts** designed to enhance workplace productivity and collaboration. Below are the detailed descriptions of their products:

1. **[Organization Chart](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/organization-chart)**  
   - Visualizes the internal structure of an organization.  
   - Displays employee names, roles, photos, and contact links.  
   - Helps teams understand reporting hierarchies and fosters better communication.

2. **[New Joinee](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/new-joinee)**  
   - Simplifies onboarding by managing profiles and introductions for new employees.  
   - Integrates with Microsoft tools to ensure smooth team integration and communication.

3. **[Employee Directory](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/employee-directory)**  
   - A centralized directory with employee names, roles, departments, and contact details.  
   - Enables quick access to colleague information across the organization.

4. **[Calendar](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/calender)**  
   - An intelligent portal for managing events, meetings, holidays, and deadlines.  
   - Ensures seamless scheduling and collaboration across teams.

5. **[Celebration](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/celebration)**  
   - Displays upcoming birthdays and work anniversaries.  
   - Allows employees to send direct wishes, fostering a positive workplace culture.

6. **[Project Management Portal](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/project-management-portal)**  
   - A SharePoint-based PMO solution for planning, tracking, and delivering projects.  
   - Features task boards, dashboards, and visibility for all stakeholders.

7. **[Learning Management System (LMS)](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/learning-management-system)**  
   - A centralized platform for online training, courses, and learning materials.  
   - Ideal for employee development and skill-building initiatives.

8. **[Audit System](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/audit-system)**  
   - A SharePoint-based solution for managing audits and compliance.  
   - Streamlines record tracking, monitoring, and evaluation for transparency.

9. **[Quick Links](https://desireinfoweb.com/products/quick-links)**  
   - A portal for quick navigation links within SharePoint intranets.  
   - Enhances user experience by providing easy access to frequently used resources.
